name: 道路
concept: A curving cobblestone lane segment with pale worn paving, low mossy curb and one small timber waypost without writing. Recognizable winding strip silhouette.

name: 房屋
concept: A compact Caribbean colonial dwelling: ochre plaster, warm terracotta hip roof, teal shutters and a tiny shaded veranda. Single snug architectural silhouette.

name: 工坊
concept: A stout carpenter's workbench with a brass hand plane, curled wood shaving and a vertical timber vise. Rich walnut and honey wood, a small steel edge. No hammer.

name: 食品
concept: A small copper cooking cauldron with vegetable stew, one ivory onion and a red pepper tucked at its base, subtle two-pixel steam. Compact appetizing copper-red silhouette. No loaf.

name: 日用
concept: A cream ceramic washbasin and small blue ceramic pitcher with a folded ivory towel, restrained indigo detailing. Compact domestic arrangement. No spool or needle.

name: 服務
concept: An elegant hanging brass lantern mounted on a short carved wooden sign bracket, warm amber glass and small teal fabric pennant. Welcoming civic hospitality symbol. No church.

name: 港口
concept: A compact harbor loading derrick with wooden jib, brass pulley and one suspended tightly wrapped cargo bundle, a tiny turquoise water strip at base. Clear crane silhouette. No anchor.

name: 農莊
concept: A little cultivated garden plot: three dark earth furrows with broad leafy green seedlings, copper watering can alongside. Rich soil and fresh foliage. No wheat sheaf.

name: 畜牧
concept: A small timber feeding trough brimming with golden hay, with a warm russet hen perched at one end and two ivory eggs at base. Rustic farming silhouette. No cow.

name: 建材
concept: A dressed pale limestone block, rough dark slate slab and two cut timber beams in a tidy compact material stack. Distinct stone facets and wood grain. No red bricks.

name: 泊位
concept: A stout cast-iron mooring bollard on a short wooden pier corner, loop of ochre rope around its horns and turquoise ripples beneath. Pier fitting silhouette. No ship.
